<!-- Source page: Bird-lg -->

BIRD looking glass in Go, for better maintainability, easier deployment & smaller memory footprint.

## Example

### Frontend

The fqdn of the routers is generated by the frontend (`$server-hostname.$domain`, for example `fra1.noc.example.com`)

### Proxy

The proxy runs on all bird router instances
